text:
zoe: design quickie  compact roles list: disabled role chips for SSO-managed orgs look interactive. users keep tapping and getting a toast 'no-op'. can we surface a better path?
arne: agree. option 1: keep chips disabled but make them focusable and open a small popover with context+audit link on Enter/Space/click. option 2: keep chips non-focusable + add a single 'View activity' link below the grid.
marta: a11y concern: if we make a disabled control focusable we must use `aria-disabled=\"true\"` and ensure screen readers get the explanatory text. popover must be reachable by keyboard and announced.
ben: eng note: popover is slightly more work but gives immediate context; deep-link is trivial. either is fine technically. prefer popover for discoverability, deep-link inside it to /audit?event=role_change&role=Admin&src=roles_ui.
zoe: copy thought: popover headline: 'Not editable here' body: 'Role assignments are managed by your identity provider. View audit history or contact your admin.' link text: 'View audit history' alt: 'Audit history'.
arne: design worry: adding focusable disabled chips could bloat tab order on pages with many roles. mitigation: only make the disabled chip focusable if it's hovered or selected, otherwise use a single aggregated action.
marta: that dynamic tab order is bad for keyboard users. recommend keeping a consistent tab sequence: chips in tab order, but use a lightweight `skip-to-audit` control after the grid that references the current selection.
ben: implementation trade-off: checkbox-style selection + aggregated link is easy; per-chip popover needs per-item event handlers. perf ok.
a11y-bot: automated scan (compact-roles-frame-v2): issues found: 1) disabled chips currently removed from DOM tab order; recommend `aria-disabled=\"true\"` plus `tabindex=\"0\"` if they open a popover. 2) tooltip reliance on `title` attribute detected. 3) ensure popover focus is moved to its first focusable element and returned on close. 4) audit link must include descriptive aria-label like 'Open audit history filtered to role Admin'.
zoe: lean product decision draft: 1) for desktop: make disabled chips keyboard-focusable (`aria-disabled`) and clicking opens small non-modal popover with copy+deep-link to audit. 2) for mobile: tapping disabled chip opens same popover. 3) add an aggregated 'View audit history for selected roles' link when multiple items selected. 4) avoid modal/slide-over this sprint.
arne: okay but add exception: if grid has >20 items, default to aggregated link to avoid long tab sequences. create an accessibility flag in code to toggle behavior.
marta: fine but document clear accessibility behavior for QA. include checklist: keyboard focusable chips, popover announced via `role=dialog` only if trapping; prefer `aria-live` polite or focus shift to heading. ensure all tooltips use `aria-describedby`. color contrast for popover text must meet 4.5:1.
ben: dev plan: we'll implement popover + audit deep-link and a feature flag to revert to aggregated link if perf or UX issues appear. will add unit tests for query params and a11y attrs.
zoe: timeline: i'll update figma with popover comps + copy by Thu EOD, dev to pick up next sprint. I'll also add analytics spec: event `roles.disabled_interaction` with props {role, method: 'popover'|'aggregated_link'}.
a11y-bot: post-change checklist: run keyboard nav test, run color contrast tests in dark/light modes, check screen reader announcement of popover, verify aria-labels for audit links, ensure no reliance on `title` attributes.
zoe: thanks all 44d i'll post the figma link when ready and ping for a quick review.
